candidates.name: CityMargin
candidates.editorial_fit: Explicit city finances, cost-of-living questions and future scenario tools
candidates.tradeoff: Margin sounds like profit and can incorrectly suggest a validated rent-income calculation

candidates.name: UrbanGauge
candidates.editorial_fit: Measured civic indicators, charts and exploration
candidates.tradeoff: May underrepresent nonurban regions; a 2007-2009 urban-indicator research system used the exact name, and a software publisher used UrbanGauge Studio; the matching .com is marketplace-listed at a premium.

candidates.name: Living Ledger
candidates.tradeoff: Existing distinct software brands use the phrase, including financial planning; higher confusion risk

candidates.name: MetroLens
candidates.editorial_fit: Memorable metropolitan analytics, strong match to planned interactive maps
candidates.tradeoff: Several distinct public services use the same/similar wording, including a transport/property data product

candidates.name: Civic Ledger
candidates.editorial_fit: Public interest, governance and reproducible datasets
candidates.tradeoff: Could imply official government sponsorship; less geographic specificity
